a51.configuration.title: 8051 Assembly (A51)
a51.format.operandColumn.description: Column where the operand field starts.
a51.format.commentColumn.description: Column where trailing line comments start.
a51.format.indentStyle.description: Whitespace character used to reach each column.
a51.format.tabSize.description: Tab stop width used when indentStyle is 'tabs'.
a51.format.longLabelStyle.description: How to handle a label too long to fit before the mnemonic column: put the instruction on its own following line ('newline'), or keep it on the same line separated by a single space ('sameLine').
a51.format.caseStyle.description: Case normalization for mnemonics, directives, and known registers. User-defined label/symbol names are never changed.
a51.format.commaSpacing.description: Whether to normalize operand lists to have exactly one space after each comma.
a51.format.semicolonSpacing.description: Whether to normalize trailing comments to have exactly one space after ';'.
a51.format.indentMacroBody.description: Indent one extra level inside MACRO/ENDM, IF/ENDIF, REPT/ENDM, and WHILE/ENDW blocks.
a51.format.maxBlankLines.description: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines to keep.
